body.x: ECORENEW Inc. (CEO Dukhyun Choi) announced that it will participate in CES 2026, the world’s largest IT and consumer electronics exhibition to be held in January 2026 in Las Vegas, USA, with a booth at Eureka Park. At the exhibition, the company plans to showcase its eco-friendly resource circulation solutions utilizing high-selectivity nano-coated filters, Renuva, along with its purification equipment line, RenewFlow.

The Renuva filters to be unveiled at CES 2026 consist of two types: the superhydrophilic Renuva-Water (RW) and the superoleophilic Renuva-Oil (RO). In addition, ECORENEW Inc. will introduce two purification systems designed for resource circulation: the RenewFlow-Water (RFW) for industrial water purification/treatment and the RenewFlow-Oil (RFO) for industrial oil regeneration.

Renuva-Water (RW) applies fine filtration based on a superhydrophilic nano-coated filter, enabling the selective permeation of water/oil by allowing only water to pass through while removing oil (in water) and other contaminants. Through this process, the purified industrial water achieves a total oil content ≤ 25 ppm.

Renuva-Oil (RO) utilizes a superoleophilic nano-coated filter to separate water (in oil) and fine particulate contaminants from lubricating oil, achieving a water content in regenerated oil ≤ 200 ppm. Both types of Renuva filters are designed to maintain coating stability and separation performance over extended operating periods, with simplified operation and maintenance enabled through cartridge replacement.

The RenewFlow system is a continuous oil-water separation system that integrates Renuva filters into an on-site continuous purification/treatment system (water) and an on-site regeneration system (oil). The RenewFlow-Water (RFW) unit performs real-time purification/treatment of cooling water and process wastewater, while the RenewFlow-Oil (RFO) unit continuously treats used lubricating oil on site, converting it into reusable, high-quality regenerated oil.

Both systems are equipped with an automated control system that enables unattended operation, and apply a low-temperature, low-pressure process to minimize energy consumption. Through waste recycling and reduced consumption of virgin oil, the systems maximize resource circulation efficiency and contribute to reducing indirect (Scope 3) emissions.

ECORENEW Inc.’s core technology converts industrial oil-in-water emulsions and water-in-oil emulsions, including emulsified oil droplets and emulsified water droplets, into high-purity reusable resources. By increasing resource circulation rates and reducing waste, the company’s solutions support corporate ESG management and contribute to achieving carbon neutrality.

Leveraging its participation in CES 2026, ECORENEW Inc. plans to strengthen collaboration with global partners and accelerate its expansion into overseas markets. The company also presented its vision to establish its advanced nano-coating purification technologies as a global standard for next-generation eco-friendly industrial purification solutions.
